title: The show or hide choice is remembered for each report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. Use the same browser throughout (the choice is kept in this browser only).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Sales in the left menu.
  2. Click Hide chart at the right of the toolbar.
  3. Click Advisor Analysis in the left menu and leave its chart shown.
  4. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  5. Click Reports and open Sales again.
  6. Click Advisor Analysis in the left menu again.
  7. Sign out, sign back in and open Sales again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Sales opens with its chart still hidden and the control reading Show chart.
  • Advisor Analysis opens with its chart still shown: hiding one report's chart did not hide another's.
  • After signing out and back in, Sales still has its chart hidden in this browser.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9583 (Story 11, Chart on the Report Page); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 11. Split out of C88624.
